method: 40 cards drawn by a2_inventory.py (random.Random(20261122).sample over the 922 oracle_ids, sorted); blocks in A2_hand_sample.txt; each block read by hand against its own Oracle text (castability present for spells, peer arithmetic and plausibility, roles, pattern hits, land facts).

hard_errors.finding: back face 7/7 not in the block; only ruling shown is a pointer to an article (no content)
Land facts say 'makes no of the deck's colours | fetches a land: no' although the text fetches a basic Forest or Plains; pattern land_onto_battlefield_effect not hit (only etb_own)

soft_findings.finding: etb_own hit on a non-creature (land/Aura/enchantment): Chulane's bounce cannot replay it; hint correct as text, misleading as synergy
noncreature_draw_or_ramp evidence is 'roles by text: ...' (a role label, not a card line); acceptable per patterns_spec, but not checkable as a quote
role combat_trick doubtful (prowess body); roles are labelled as fallible
